scope: RewindBox skins orientation and PS2 Pocket lot (PR #152, squashed as 705e90c7, reviewed by the integration session): the ARMSX2 bridge podspec adds Apple's QuartzCore and CoreGraphics system frameworks (the skin overlay masks the game window with CAShapeLayer and draws PDF skin art with CGPDF); assets/skins/pocket gains the third original pack, PS2 Pocket - matte black, generated by tools/skins/build_ps2_pocket.py and tools/skins/ps2_art.py (original RewindBox artwork; PlayStation names and marks belong to their owners, no third-party artwork or font bundled). No hosted package, dependency, engine, Core or vendored native source change.
